description: The Parliament of Sri Lanka - Summoned the Parliament to meet on Friday the 14th of February, 2025 by the Speaker  of  Parliament
reasoning: This gazette content specifically announces the convening of Parliament on a specific date and time, which falls under electoral and parliamentary processes. The notification by the Speaker about summoning Parliament constitutes an official announcement about parliamentary proceedings, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7) as it deals with the scheduling and convening of legislative sessions.
